verdicts.reason: A is just the original portrait layout dropped into the middle of the square, with large empty white strips left and right. The yellow dash accents have come loose and float to the left of the photo, and the top yellow bar sits off-centre against the right edge, so it reads as an unadapted copy. Its one strength is that the headline still sits over the photo the way the original does. B does rearrange the design, but the thin yellow frame on the left is mostly empty: the headline box is pushed into its top third with dead white space below, and nothing links it to the photo beside it. The dash accents are scattered over the photo, the top yellow bar is stranded at the top, and the photo is cut off from the brand frame, so the original's layered look is lost.
